messages:
alex_g: Hey team — PR #9834 touches routing and tiling for slimline serving. I'm pausing the merge until we have architecture eyes and an RFC link. @maya_k can you paste the RFC pointer? Need to confirm fallback/guardrail behavior before we flip the canary.

maya_k: Sorry, running into meetings. RFC is in drive: https://go.redwood/rfc/slimline-tiling — the doc is still marked DRAFT, we should confirm ownership.

samir: Thanks @maya_k. @zoe can you do a quick skim for safety and SLO impact? Also need to know if this requires a config toggle for dedicated clusters.

zoe: I can look — will check the fallback section. Quick note: the KV cache assumptions changed, might add a perf delta. I'll post a short summary in ~45m.

alex_g: Appreciate it. Also @deploy-bot can you hold canary deployment for PR 9834 until we get arch ack?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary hold added for pr=9834 by alex_g — status: held. Use `/deploy override` with `arch-approval` tag to release.

maya_k: Ownership: ops-platform team. I pinged @irene from ops-platform for signoff.

irene: On it; will check RFC + run quick perf sim on staging. ETA ~2h. If guardrails look good we can allow merge with canary=10% for 2h.

samir: Sounds good. Alex — can you add the RFC link + brief SLO delta to the PR description? Makes approvals faster.

alex_g: Done — PR body updated with RFC link + noted possible 5-10% tail latency increase in worst-case and mitigation via cache TTL.

zoe: Skim done. Main concern is shard-affinity scan during warmup; recommend adding a canary traffic split and a fallback route to previous model variant. +1 pending irene perf check.

irene: Perf sim: tail p95 increases by ~6% at 95th percentile with current staging load. Can limit by setting `batch_size` cap; prepared patch for runtime config. Approve to merge with canary and rollback policy.

alex_g: Thx. Tagging @samir for final merge since you requested the review.

samir: lgtm, thanks all. Merging now and will monitor dashboards. If errors spike we rollback. :rocket:
